targets.evidence_quote: In this paper, we present a replication study with new data using the same protocol as the cornerstone study by Leventhal et al.21 22
targets.outcome_quote: For this study, we replicated an American cornerstone study21 22 on the association between e-cigarette use and tobacco smoking in the Netherlands and Flanders and found similar results.
